Question ID: MCR_U03_L07_Quiz_Q01

Which response best supports this statistical report skill: interpret a two-way table?

answer.text: Use the table, display, sample, and claim together before writing a conclusion.

feedback.text: Correct. A responsible report interpretation checks evidence, context, sample, and limits.

feedback.text: One number is not enough to evaluate a full statistical report.

answer.text: Ignore who was sampled.

feedback.text: The sample affects whether the conclusion can generalize.
